notes.title: Partial Controller Support Added
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for playing "Frog & Blade".
Today, we have released an official Steam Input layout to provide partial controller support for the game.
This allows you to perform basic operations using various gamepads and the Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]\[Example Controls (Steam Deck / Xbox Controller)][/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Left Stick:[/b] Move Cursor[/p][/*][*][p][b]A Button:[/b] Left Click[/p][/*][*][p][b]X Button:[/b] Close Text Box[/p][/*][*][p][b]Y Button:[/b] View Backlog[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hold L1/LB Button:[/b] Skip[/p][/*][/list][p]You can also customize these bindings to your liking via the Steam Input settings.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]\[Important Notes][/b][/p][list][*][p]Aiming with an analog stick can be difficult in the combat minigame, so we recommend using a mouse or touchscreen for these sections. Alternatively, if you wish to play through the entire game with a controller, please consider using the combat skip feature.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your continued support of "Frog & Blade".[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "Frog & Blade"!
Today, we have released a patch (Version 1.0.1) to address a bug.

[Fixes]
- Fixed an issue where a "no textbox exists~" error could occur during scene transitions under specific conditions, preventing character sprites from displaying correctly.

[Important Notice]
- After applying this update, loading a save file may return you to the beginning of the current scene. We sincerely apologize for this inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

Thank you to everyone who reported this bug.
If you find that the bug persists or discover any new issues, it would be a great help if you could report them in the community discussions.

We look forward to your continued support for "Frog & Blade".
